rachel_sales: Prospect (regulated payments) needs BYO-HSM + vendor-managed HSM option, attestation artifacts, and a monthly rotation window (local 01:00-03:00). Need SOW bullets + pricing delta by EOD.
vikram_se: Paste RFP snippets? I want to check network & import constraints.
rachel_sales: From RFP: customer HSM allowed (PKCS#11), key import via wrapped blob or onsite ceremony, attestation (vendor-signed PEM + firmware hashes), private peering only, escrow export option, pricing delta for managed HSM and per-op surcharge.
anya_crypto: We support PKCS#11 and a connector that runs in customer VPC. Wrapped blobs are unwrapped only inside the HSM connector or vendor-managed appliance. No plaintext in control plane.
martin_ops: Rotation plan: stage new key, atomic pointer swap, keep previous key for TTL to allow rollback, then garbage collect. This avoids cache flushes and keeps latency stable. 2h window is tight but doable with zero-downtime pointer switch.
sophia_fin: For pricing I need expected peak qps and desired HA connectors. What did they list?
rachel_sales: They listed 220 qps peak, latency-sensitive.
sophia_fin: Ok assume 2 connectors for HA. Pricing model: managed-HSM hourly + per-crypto-op premium + one-off SOW for escrow/ceremony. I'll draft numbers.
legal_bot: Automated: attach security Q snippet required for Q5.3 -> s3://legal/templates/sec-qna-Q5.3.pdf
anya_crypto: Draft security blurb: "Redwood does not persist unwrapped customer key material. Wrapped key blobs are transferred and only unwrapped inside the customer's HSM connector or vendor-managed appliance. Audit logs capture operation metadata and key IDs only."
rachel_sales: Great. Please attach example attestation PEM and a simple network diagram PNG when ready. Will compile and send to procurement. :pray:
